title: Create shipping labels from the order page
description: Adds CreateLabelAsync, which buys a carrier label and stores the tracking number on the order.

expected_issues.description: `FirstOrDefaultAsync` returns null for an unknown order id, and `order.ShippingAddress` is dereferenced without a check, producing a NullReferenceException (500) instead of the `OrderNotFoundException` that `VoidLabelAsync` throws.
